text:
Nina: Quick thread to codify SI + marketplace lead rules for NodeBridge and HW partners. Goal: clarity on triage SLAs, crediting, demos, and announcement gating.

Jared: Proposal: marketplace leads = 24h triage; hardware referrals = 72h triage. Default SI credit 20% for <$200k, tiers escalate.

Mei: Agree on SLA split. Also require `si_claim` tag in CRM and a `/lead-claim` command to record who owns it.

Ruth: Important: SE demo hours must be tracked as `si_se_hours` on the lead so finance can charge back. If partner provides demo, set hours = 0.

Nina: Draft rules: 1) SLA: marketplace 24h, hardware 72h; 2) metadata: `si_partner`, `si_credited_pct`, `si_engaged`, `si_se_hours`, `source_channel`; 3) AE + SI must acknowledge ownership in thread within 48h after claim (72h for >$250k deals).

Jared: For announcements: mutual 10 business day notice, signed customer opt-in required for naming/quotes. No exceptions without Legal OK.

Mei: Intake schema I'll push to the gateway. Example snippet: ```json
{"lead_id":"string","source":"marketplace|hardware|referral","si_partner":"string","si_credited_pct":20,"si_engaged":true,"si_se_hours":0,"claimed_by":"string","claim_ts":"iso8601"}
```

Ruth: Edge cases: two partners claim same account -> first claim + AE confirmation wins. Disputes escalate to Partner Ops within 5 business days.

partner-bot: Tip: use `/announce-checklist` to attach the announcement gate items: commercial commit, legal approval, embargo window, quote sign-off.

Nina: Action items: @Mei PR to gateway + dashboard filter for `source=marketplace`; @Jared update partner profiles for NodeBridge exceptions; @Ruth liaise with Finance on `si_se_hours` billing. I'll consolidate into Confluence after comments. Thanks! :raised_hands:
